name: Overeating
overview: Scripture warns against the dangers of overeating and excessive indulgence, portraying it as a lack of self-control and a source of shame. Proverbs cautions those given to appetite to exercise strict discipline, even to the point of restraint, and advises against associating with riotous eaters and winebibbers. The pursuit of excessive pleasure, such as eating too much honey, is likened to seeking false glory, which is not true honor. Paul further condemns those whose god is their belly, highlighting the spiritual destruction that follows when earthly desires dominate one's life. Ultimately, healing and salvation come from the Lord, who alone can deliver us from these harmful patterns.
